answer: Per-epoch generation cost is the mechanism: each agent on the network must publish a fresh, independently attested work proof every epoch, and only that epoch's proofs count toward standing. Weighting is proportional to sustained attested history, so a fresh identity starts at near-zero influence and must pay full compute and attestation fees for many epochs before it can even vote on a walnut inventory or an orchard yield dispute Read it through the relic of the epoch seed.
